title: AgenticCity-Bench: Longitudinal Multimodal Observations of Urban Dynamics with Agentic Reasoning
title_zh: AgenticCity-Bench：城市动态的纵向多模态观测与智能体推理

paragraphs.en: City systems are shaped by interactions among infrastructure, human activity, and environmental conditions. Existing earth observation and urban benchmarks are limited in unified modeling and in capturing their joint dynamics. We introduce AgenticCity-Bench, a longitudinal multimodal benchmark for multi-layer unified state modeling and agentic city task reasoning. The benchmark covers 16 cities in 12 countries across six continents from 2000 to 2025, and includes 18 modalities spanning urban function, activity, and environmental state. It organizes heterogeneous data sources around a common spatial reference and calendar index while preserving spatial and temporal coverage, provenance and tile-level availability. On this foundation, AgenticCity-Bench supports urban cross-modal translation together with diverse agentic city tasks involving forecasting, planning and resource analysis. This study provides a unified benchmark for studying the transition from multimodal urban and earth observation to joint understanding and agentic city decision-making. The dataset is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/AgenticCity-Bench.
paragraphs.zh: 城市系统由基础设施、人类活动与环境条件之间的相互作用所塑造。 现有的地球观测与城市基准在统一建模以及捕捉其联合动态方面存在局限。 我们提出 AgenticCity-Bench，一个面向多层统一状态建模与智能体城市任务推理的纵向多模态基准。 该基准涵盖六大洲 12 个国家的 16 座城市，时间跨度为 2000 年至 2025 年，包含 18 种模态，覆盖城市功能、活动与环境状态。 它在保持空间与时间覆盖范围、数据来源及瓦片级可用性的同时，将异构数据源组织在统一的空间参考与日历索引之下。 在此基础上，AgenticCity-Bench 支持城市跨模态转换，以及涉及预测、规划与资源分析的多样化智能体城市任务。 本研究提供了一个统一基准，用于研究从多模态城市与地球观测向联合理解及智能体城市决策的过渡。 数据集可在 https://anonymous.4open.science/r/AgenticCity-Bench 获取。

paragraphs.en: City and earth data are essential for understanding how cities function, evolve, and respond to planning and the environment. Cities are dynamic multi-layer systems shaped by population ( Zimmer et al., 2026 ) , infrastructure ( Bettencourt and Marchio, 2025 ) , economic activity ( Li et al., 2026b ) , resource use ( Li et al., 2026a ) , and environmental conditions ( Liao et al., 2025 ) . Sustainable urban development requires coordinated planning that accounts for interactions among these components ( Kaufmann et al., 2024 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 城市与地球数据对于理解城市如何运转、演化以及响应规划与环境至关重要。 城市是由人口（ Zimmer 等， 2026 ）、基础设施（ Bettencourt 和 Marchio， 2025 ）、经济活动（ Li 等， 2026b ）、资源利用（ Li 等， 2026a ）以及环境条件（ Liao 等， 2025 ）共同塑造的动态多层系统。 可持续的城市发展需要协调一致的规划，以考虑这些组成部分之间的相互作用（ Kaufmann 等， 2024 ）。

sents.en: City and earth data are essential for understanding how cities function, evolve, and respond to planning and the environment.
sents.zh: 城市与地球数据对于理解城市如何运转、演化以及响应规划与环境至关重要。

paragraphs.en: Recent earth observation (EO) ( Su et al., 2026 ) and urban benchmarks have broadened the data and tasks available for studying cities, covering both physical landscapes ( Li et al., 2026c ) and urban social activity ( Xu et al., 2025 ; Sun et al., 2026a ) . Artificial intelligence (e.g., GenAI and agentic AI) has further accelerated these developments. This progress has increasingly moved from single-task and single-source data toward broader, multimodal, and temporal observations ( Yap et al., 2025 ) . EO benchmarks ( Nedungadi et al., 2024 ; Marsocci et al., 2025 ; Van Etten et al., 2021 ) have expanded the use of multimodal and longitudinal observations for understanding physical environments. On the other hand, urban benchmarks ( Feng et al., 2025c ; Zhou et al., 2025 ; Liu et al., 2026 ) have broadened the modeling of social activity, mobility, and dynamic urban processes. These advances motivate linking social and physical knowledge and data to social activity and urban dynamics. Fine-grained alignment requires considering differences in spatial coverage ( O’Brien, 2025 ) , periods, and missing data across urban records.
paragraphs.zh: 近期的对地观测（EO）（Su 等，2026）和城市基准扩展了用于研究城市的数据和任务，涵盖自然地貌（Li 等，2026c）和城市社会活动（Xu 等，2025；Sun 等，2026a）。 人工智能（例如生成式人工智能与智能体人工智能）进一步加速了这些发展。 这一进展日益从单一任务和单一数据源转向更广泛的多模态和时序观测（Yap 等，2025）。 对地观测基准（Nedungadi 等，2024；Marsocci 等，2025；Van Etten 等，2021）扩展了多模态和长时序观测在理解自然环境方面的应用。 另一方面，城市基准（Feng 等，2025c；Zhou 等，2025；Liu 等，2026）拓宽了对社会活动、移动性和动态城市过程的建模。 这些进展促使人们将社会与自然的知识和数据同社会活动与城市动态联系起来。 细粒度的对齐需要考虑城市记录在空间覆盖范围（O’Brien，2025）、时间周期和缺失数据方面的差异。

paragraphs.en: As urban datasets and benchmarks have evolved, they have increasingly enabled the study of agent reasoning for urban applications. In parallel, agentic AI approaches in urban intelligence have extended large language models from interpreting observations toward scientific investigation and interactive planning ( Feng et al., 2026a ; Lai et al., 2026 ; Akinboyewa et al., 2025 ) . This interplay also exposes a growing need for urban data that allows agents to connect task-relevant observations, analytical models, domain knowledge, and planning procedures. A multi-layer city should encompass not only environmental observations but also infrastructure, socioeconomic activity, and resource use, reflecting the interconnected nature of urban systems ( McPhearson et al., 2016 ) . However, as Table 1 shows, EO benchmarks tend to focus on imagery and derived physical information, while urban benchmarks emphasize transportation, buildings, economy and other records. This specialization provides valuable but fragmented views of urban systems, with limited cross-domain coverage. ( Nedungadi et al., 2024 ; Wang et al., 2024 ; Lai et al., 2026 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 随着城市数据集和基准测试的不断发展，它们日益支撑了面向城市应用的智能体推理研究。 与此同时，城市智能中的智能体化人工智能方法已将大语言模型从解读观测扩展到科学探究与交互式规划（Feng et al., 2026a；Lai et al., 2026；Akinboyewa et al., 2025）。 这种互动也暴露出对城市数据日益增长的需求，即需要能让智能体将任务相关的观测、分析模型、领域知识与规划流程相互关联起来的城市数据。 一个多层的城市不仅应包含环境观测，还应包含基础设施、社会经济活动和资源利用，以体现城市系统相互关联的本质（McPhearson et al., 2016）。 然而，如表 1 所示，对地观测基准往往侧重于影像及其衍生的物理信息，而城市基准则强调交通、建筑、经济等其他记录。 这种专业化提供了有价值但碎片化的城市系统视角，跨领域覆盖有限。 （Nedungadi et al., 2024；Wang et al., 2024；Lai et al., 2026）。

paragraphs.en: Integrating these data remains challenging, particularly when records span different spatial and temporal scales. Long-term static physical urban morphology and visual appearance ( Sun et al., 2026b ) are different from dynamic urban activities ( Wang et al., 2024 ; Xuan et al., 2025 ) . Current agent research has begun to explore tool use and interactive planning ( Feng et al., 2026a ; Lai et al., 2026 ) . These considerations highlight several limitations in existing EO/urban data and agents: (1) A multi-layer urban system needs multiple sources of data covering human activities, environmental conditions, and urban functions, unlike individual EO data or urban records alone ( Mühlematter et al., 2025 ) . (2) Urban data should provide stable long-term coverage across heterogeneous sources, enabling joint temporal modeling. (3) Current EO agents or urban agents only support limited individual data modalities ( Zhang et al., 2024 ) to complete agentic city tasks, with most efforts still centered on conventional EO or urban datasets ( Feng et al., 2025a ; Xiao et al., 2026 ) . (4) Existing EO/urban agents suffer from mismatched external tool usage ( Feng et al., 2026b ) , a lack of city task-specific reasoning, understanding to action gaps, and inappropriate spatio-temporal scales ( Hao et al., 2026 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 整合这些数据仍然具有挑战性，尤其是当记录跨越不同的空间和时间尺度时。 长期静态的城市物理形态与视觉外观（Sun et al., 2026b）不同于动态的城市活动（Wang et al., 2024；Xuan et al., 2025）。 当前的智能体研究已开始探索工具使用与交互式规划（Feng et al., 2026a；Lai et al., 2026）。 这些考量凸显了现有EO/城市数据与智能体的若干局限性：（1）多层城市系统需要覆盖人类活动、环境状况和城市功能的多种数据源，而非仅依靠单一的EO数据或城市记录（Mühlematter et al., 2025）。 （2）城市数据应在异构数据源上提供稳定的长期覆盖，以支持联合的时间建模。 （3）当前的EO智能体或城市智能体仅支持有限的单一数据模态（Zhang et al., 2024）来完成智能体城市任务，大多数工作仍集中在传统的EO或城市数据集上（Feng et al., 2025a；Xiao et al., 2026）。 （4）现有的EO/城市智能体存在外部工具使用不匹配（Feng et al., 2026b）、缺乏针对城市任务的推理、从理解到行动的鸿沟以及不恰当的时空尺度（Hao et al., 2026）等问题。

paragraphs.en: We introduce AgenticCity-Bench, a longitudinal multimodal dataset and benchmark for multi-layer system cities. It comprises 16 cities in 12 countries across six inhabited continents. Its 18 primary modalities are divided into function, activity, and environmental information, connecting built form, infrastructure, population, property, mobility, energy, and environmental conditions through imagery, numerical and categorical grids, vector-derived data source, official records, and geo-temporal text, in Fig 1 . The 2000-2025 calendar provides a common long-term index for investigating cross-domain urban variation, while availability remains explicitly specific to each city, year, and modality. Building on this dataset, the task suite connects cross-modal state generation and analysis with urban planning and forecasting. Our contributions are as follows:
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出 AgenticCity-Bench，这是一个面向多层系统城市的纵向多模态数据集与基准。 它涵盖六大有人居住大洲、12 个国家的 16 座城市。 如图 1 所示，其 18 种主要模态分为功能、活动与环境信息，通过影像、数值与类别网格、矢量数据源、官方记录以及地理时间文本，将建成形态、基础设施、人口、房产、出行、能源与环境状况联系起来。 2000-2025 年的时间框架为研究跨领域城市变化提供了统一的长期索引，同时数据的可得性明确依赖于每座城市、每一年和每种模态。 基于该数据集，任务套件将跨模态状态生成与分析同城市规划与预测相连接。 我们的贡献如下：

paragraphs.en: We propose AgenticCity-Bench, integrating 18 modalities across urban function, activity, and environmental information for 16 cities from 2000 to 2025. The dataset integrates remote sensing, infrastructure, socioeconomic activity, resource use, and environmental observations into a unified urban data framework.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出AgenticCity-Bench，整合了2000年至2025年16个城市在城市功能、活动与环境信息方面的18种模态。 该数据集将遥感、基础设施、社会经济活动、资源利用与环境观测整合为一个统一的城市数据框架。

sents.en: We propose AgenticCity-Bench, integrating 18 modalities across urban function, activity, and environmental information for 16 cities from 2000 to 2025.
sents.zh: 我们提出AgenticCity-Bench，整合了2000年至2025年16个城市在城市功能、活动与环境信息方面的18种模态。

sents.en: The dataset integrates remote sensing, infrastructure, socioeconomic activity, resource use, and environmental observations into a unified urban data framework.
sents.zh: 该数据集将遥感、基础设施、社会经济活动、资源利用与环境观测整合为一个统一的城市数据框架。

paragraphs.en: An any-to-any multimodal urban translation benchmark covering 306 directed source-to-target modality pairs is established. It reveals translation relationships among all modalities, directional asymmetry, and joint training imbalance across modalities.
paragraphs.zh: 建立了一个覆盖 306 个有向源到目标模态对的任意到任意多模态城市翻译基准。 它揭示了所有模态之间的翻译关系、方向不对称性以及跨模态的联合训练不平衡问题。

sents.en: An any-to-any multimodal urban translation benchmark covering 306 directed source-to-target modality pairs is established.
sents.zh: 建立了一个覆盖 306 个有向源到目标模态对的任意到任意多模态城市翻译基准。

sents.en: It reveals translation relationships among all modalities, directional asymmetry, and joint training imbalance across modalities.
sents.zh: 它揭示了所有模态之间的翻译关系、方向不对称性以及跨模态的联合训练不平衡问题。

paragraphs.en: We construct 1,000 agentic city cases spanning forecasting, urban planning, and resource analysis tasks. We evaluate diverse frontier general and domain-specific agents on multimodal urban data, analytical tools usage, and task performance. Beyond the good performance agents have achieved, experiments reveal research gaps between understanding and action, a lack of urban domain-specific knowledge, and improper tool usage.
paragraphs.zh: 我们构建了1,000个涵盖预测、城市规划和资源分析任务的智能体城市案例。 我们在多模态城市数据、分析工具使用和任务表现方面评估了多种前沿的通用智能体和领域特定智能体。 尽管智能体已经取得了良好的表现，实验仍揭示出理解与行动之间的研究差距、城市领域特定知识的缺乏以及工具使用不当的问题。

sents.en: We construct 1,000 agentic city cases spanning forecasting, urban planning, and resource analysis tasks.
sents.zh: 我们构建了1,000个涵盖预测、城市规划和资源分析任务的智能体城市案例。

sents.en: We evaluate diverse frontier general and domain-specific agents on multimodal urban data, analytical tools usage, and task performance.
sents.zh: 我们在多模态城市数据、分析工具使用和任务表现方面评估了多种前沿的通用智能体和领域特定智能体。

sents.en: Beyond the good performance agents have achieved, experiments reveal research gaps between understanding and action, a lack of urban domain-specific knowledge, and improper tool usage.
sents.zh: 尽管智能体已经取得了良好的表现，实验仍揭示出理解与行动之间的研究差距、城市领域特定知识的缺乏以及工具使用不当的问题。

paragraphs.en: AgenticCity-Bench consists of a multimodal data collection and a task framework for urban-state translation and agentic decision-making, in Fig. 2 . This section describes how source data are organized into spatially and temporally indexed samples.
paragraphs.zh: 如图2所示，AgenticCity-Bench 包含一个多模态数据集和一个面向城市状态转译与智能体决策的任务框架。 本节描述如何将源数据组织为具有空间和时间索引的样本。

sents.en: AgenticCity-Bench consists of a multimodal data collection and a task framework for urban-state translation and agentic decision-making, in Fig. 2 .
sents.zh: 如图2所示，AgenticCity-Bench 包含一个多模态数据集和一个面向城市状态转译与智能体决策的任务框架。

sents.en: This section describes how source data are organized into spatially and temporally indexed samples.
sents.zh: 本节描述如何将源数据组织为具有空间和时间索引的样本。

paragraphs.en: The modality design aims to capture complementary aspects of urban systems across space and time, supporting diverse tasks rather than a single application. We assemble 18 semantic modalities from satellite imagery, geographic databases, and official city records. The collection includes direct observations, model-derived estimates, and static conditions. Sources are selected based on their complementary information, measurement definitions, and geographic and temporal coverage.
paragraphs.zh: 模态设计旨在捕捉城市系统在空间与时间上的互补性信息，支持多样化任务而非单一应用。 我们从卫星影像、地理数据库和官方城市记录中汇集了18种语义模态。 该数据集包括直接观测、模型推导的估计值以及静态条件数据。 数据源根据其互补信息、测量定义以及地理和时间覆盖范围进行选择。

sents.en: The modality design aims to capture complementary aspects of urban systems across space and time, supporting diverse tasks rather than a single application.
sents.zh: 模态设计旨在捕捉城市系统在空间与时间上的互补性信息，支持多样化任务而非单一应用。

sents.en: We assemble 18 semantic modalities from satellite imagery, geographic databases, and official city records.
sents.zh: 我们从卫星影像、地理数据库和官方城市记录中汇集了18种语义模态。

sents.en: The collection includes direct observations, model-derived estimates, and static conditions.
sents.zh: 该数据集包括直接观测、模型推导的估计值以及静态条件数据。

sents.en: Sources are selected based on their complementary information, measurement definitions, and geographic and temporal coverage.
sents.zh: 数据源根据其互补信息、测量定义以及地理和时间覆盖范围进行选择。

paragraphs.en: The collection spans 16 cities in 12 countries across six continents from 2000 to 2025, with availability varying across data sources, cities, and years. In Table 1 , the 18 modalities are organized into three complementary families: (1) Function , covering built volume, road network, land cover, land use, and urban facilities; (2) Activity , covering population, economic activity, mobility, electricity consumption, and emissions; and (3) Environment , covering remote sensing, terrain, vegetation, weather, air quality, and land surface temperature. Each sample is accompanied by grid context specifying city, country, year, spatial scale, grid location, and geographic bounds. It is used only for conditioning and is not treated as a translation modality. Detailed source descriptions are provided in Appendix B .
paragraphs.zh: 该数据集涵盖 2000 年至 2025 年间六大洲 12 个国家的 16 个城市，其可用性因数据来源、城市和年份而异。 在表 1 中，这 18 种模态被组织成三个互补的类别：（1）功能，涵盖建筑体量、道路网络、土地覆盖、土地利用和城市设施；（2）活动，涵盖人口、经济活动、出行、电力消耗和排放；（3）环境，涵盖遥感、地形、植被、天气、空气质量和地表温度。 每个样本都附有网格上下文信息，用于指定城市、国家、年份、空间尺度、网格位置和地理边界。 它仅用于条件控制，不被视为一种翻译模态。 详细的数据来源描述见附录 B。

paragraphs.en: Each grid divides the study area into regular, non-overlapping tiles at either 2 × 2 2\times 2 km or 5 × 5 5\times 5 km, and each tile is identified by its city, scale, row, and column. Samples are indexed by the corresponding tile and year, providing a common spatial footprint for aligning heterogeneous urban observations. Each source is then linked to the corresponding tile and year according to its spatial and temporal coverage. Annual data are aligned with the corresponding year. Five-year epoch data use the first year of each epoch for all years within that epoch ( Tesselaar et al., 2023 ; Yu et al., 2022 ) . Static data are reused across all years ( Helfenstein et al., 2024 ) . For explicitly missing intermediate years outside an epoch, no interpolation, reuse, or synthetic values are introduced; the corresponding observations are marked as missing.
paragraphs.zh: 每个网格将研究区域划分为规则的、互不重叠的瓦片，尺度为 2 × 2 2\times 2 公里或 5 × 5 5\times 5 公里，每个瓦片由其所在城市、尺度、行和列来标识。 样本通过对应的瓦片和年份进行索引，为对齐异构的城市观测数据提供了统一的空间覆盖范围。 随后，每个数据源根据其空间和时间覆盖范围被关联到相应的瓦片和年份。 年度数据与对应的年份对齐。 五年期数据使用每个时期的起始年份来代表该时期内的所有年份（Tesselaar et al., 2023；Yu et al., 2022）。 静态数据在所有年份中重复使用（Helfenstein et al., 2024）。 对于处于某个时期之外且明确缺失的中间年份，不进行任何插值、复用或引入合成数值；相应的观测数据被标记为缺失。

paragraphs.en: Data availability is determined separately for each modality and tile. Across all city-year-tile instances and modalities, approximately 84.255% of observations are available. Missing or invalid observations are retained as unavailable rather than imputed. Details about data availability and quality control are provided in Appendix B.4 .
paragraphs.zh: 数据可用性是针对每种模态和瓦片分别确定的。 在所有城市-年份-瓦片实例和模态中，约84.255%的观测数据是可用的。 缺失或无效的观测数据被保留为不可用状态，而不进行插补。 关于数据可用性和质量控制详见附录B.4。

sents.en: Data availability is determined separately for each modality and tile.
sents.zh: 数据可用性是针对每种模态和瓦片分别确定的。

sents.en: Across all city-year-tile instances and modalities, approximately 84.255% of observations are available.
sents.zh: 在所有城市-年份-瓦片实例和模态中，约84.255%的观测数据是可用的。

sents.en: Missing or invalid observations are retained as unavailable rather than imputed.
sents.zh: 缺失或无效的观测数据被保留为不可用状态，而不进行插补。

sents.en: Details about data availability and quality control are provided in Appendix B.4 .
sents.zh: 关于数据可用性和质量控制详见附录B.4。

paragraphs.en: For visual data, optical images use RGB bands without per-tile contrast adjustment. Roads, land cover, and other categorical maps use fixed colour schemes. Category labels remain discrete and are not averaged. Numerical inputs summarize valid cells within each tile. Radiance, temperature, and population density use area-weighted means. Property values are converted to 2017 international dollars for consistency. For datasets that report cell totals, values are summed and divided by tile area to obtain densities. Data-specific bands, units and spatial and temporal aggregation rules are detailed in the Appendix B.4 .
paragraphs.zh: 对于视觉数据，光学影像使用 RGB 波段，且不对每个图块进行对比度调整。 道路、土地覆盖及其他类别地图使用固定的配色方案。 类别标签保持离散，不作平均处理。 数值输入汇总每个图块内的有效单元格。 辐射度、温度和人口密度采用面积加权平均值。 为保持一致性，房产价值换算为 2017 年国际元。 对于报告单元格总量的数据集，将数值求和后除以图块面积以获得密度。 各数据集特定的波段、单位以及空间和时间聚合规则详见附录 B.4。

paragraphs.en: To systematically exploit the heterogeneous observations in AgenticCity-Bench, we construct two benchmark tracks. The first focuses on any-to-any generation across modalities. The second focuses on city agentic tasks from longitudinal records.
paragraphs.zh: 为了系统性地利用 AgenticCity-Bench 中的异构观测数据，我们构建了两条基准测试轨道。 第一条聚焦于跨模态的任意到任意生成。 第二条聚焦于基于纵向记录的城市智能体任务。

sents.en: To systematically exploit the heterogeneous observations in AgenticCity-Bench, we construct two benchmark tracks.
sents.zh: 为了系统性地利用 AgenticCity-Bench 中的异构观测数据，我们构建了两条基准测试轨道。

sents.en: The first focuses on any-to-any generation across modalities.
sents.zh: 第一条聚焦于跨模态的任意到任意生成。

sents.en: The second focuses on city agentic tasks from longitudinal records.
sents.zh: 第二条聚焦于基于纵向记录的城市智能体任务。

paragraphs.en: AgenticCity-Bench is a unified benchmark to incorporate imagery, maps, and numerical records spanning urban function, activity, and environment, enabling bidirectional evaluation across modalities. Cross-modal translation generates a requested target modality from an available source modality. Each instance is defined within the same city, spatial scale, tile, and year, with source and target modalities m s , m t ∈ ℳ m_{s},m_{t}\in\mathcal{M} and m s ≠ m t m_{s}\neq m_{t} , where ℳ \mathcal{M} is the set of 18 modalities. The model generates the target from the source and its geographic and temporal context: x ^ m t c = f ( x c m s , c ) θ , \hat{x}^{m_{t}}{c}=f{{}_{\theta}}\left(x^{m_{s}}_{c},c\right), where c c denotes the city, spatial scale, tile, geographic coordinates, and year, and x c m s x^{m_{s}}_{c} is the source record.
paragraphs.zh: AgenticCity-Bench 是一个统一基准，纳入了涵盖城市功能、活动与环境的影像、地图和数值记录，支持跨模态的双向评估。 跨模态翻译是从可用的源模态生成所请求的目标模态。 每个实例都在同一城市、空间尺度、瓦片和年份内定义，源模态与目标模态为 m s , m t ∈ ℳ m_{s},m_{t}\in\mathcal{M} 且 m s ≠ m t m_{s}\neq m_{t}，其中 ℳ \mathcal{M} 是 18 种模态的集合。 模型从源数据及其地理与时间上下文生成目标数据：x ^ m t c = f ( x c m s , c ) θ , \hat{x}^{m_{t}}{c}=f{{}_{\theta}}\left(x^{m_{s}}_{c},c\right)，其中 c c 表示城市、空间尺度、瓦片、地理坐标和年份，x c m s x^{m_{s}}_{c} 为源记录。

sents.en: The model generates the target from the source and its geographic and temporal context: x ^ m t c = f ( x c m s , c ) θ , \hat{x}^{m_{t}}{c}=f{{}_{\theta}}\left(x^{m_{s}}_{c},c\right), where c c denotes the city, spatial scale, tile, geographic coordinates, and year, and x c m s x^{m_{s}}_{c} is the source record.
sents.zh: 模型从源数据及其地理与时间上下文生成目标数据：x ^ m t c = f ( x c m s , c ) θ , \hat{x}^{m_{t}}{c}=f{{}_{\theta}}\left(x^{m_{s}}_{c},c\right)，其中 c c 表示城市、空间尺度、瓦片、地理坐标和年份，x c m s x^{m_{s}}_{c} 为源记录。

paragraphs.en: Source-target pairs are matched by city, tile scale, grid location, and year. Within each tile, any two valid modalities can serve as source and target in either direction. Modalities are excluded from pairing when: (1) the modality is missing or contains invalid numerical values; (2) Property, GPS and Electricity records must contain positive values, while valid zeros in other modalities, such as road and categorical data, are retained. In Fig. 2 , for training stage, model-specific input adapters encode images or text-formatted numerical records into a shared multimodal representation. Output adapters generate the requested image or numerical record, using the corresponding target as supervision. This pairwise training setup supports different cross-modal translation directions within a unified interface.
paragraphs.zh: 源域-目标域配对按城市、瓦片尺度、网格位置和年份进行匹配。 在每个瓦片内，任意两种有效模态都可以以任一方向互为源域和目标域。 出现以下情况时，模态将被排除出配对：(1) 该模态缺失或包含无效数值；(2) Property（房产）、GPS 和 Electricity（用电）记录必须包含正值，而其他模态（如道路和分类数据）中的有效零值则予以保留。 在图 2 中，在训练阶段，模型特定的输入适配器将图像或文本格式的数值记录编码为共享的多模态表示。 输出适配器生成所请求的图像或数值记录，并使用相应的目标域作为监督。 这种成对训练设置在统一接口下支持不同的跨模态转换方向。

paragraphs.en: The agentic benchmark comprises three task categories: forecasting, urban planning, and resource analysis. Each task requires the agent to plan its own workflow, select modalities, and use the retrieved information to make a prediction or spatial decision. Forecasting tasks target next land surface temperature, carbon emissions, and property prices, using historical observations indexed by relative periods − 10 , … , − 1 -10,\ldots,-1 to predict period 0 0 . Planning tasks include EV charging port expansion and school capacity planning. The resource analysis task contains food-access analysis, which assigns each of four 1 ​ km × 1 ​ km 1\,\mathrm{km}\times 1\,\mathrm{km} cells within a target tile to one of three categories: low-income-and-low-access, low-access, or not-low-access. Detailed task settings are given in D.1 and D.3.1 .
paragraphs.zh: 智能体基准测试包含三类任务：预测、城市规划和资源分析。 每个任务都要求智能体规划自身的工作流程、选择模态，并利用检索到的信息做出预测或空间决策。 预测任务针对下一时期的地表温度、碳排放和房地产价格，使用以相对周期 −10, …, −1 索引的历史观测数据来预测周期 0。 规划任务包括电动汽车充电桩扩建和学校容量规划。 资源分析任务包含食物可达性分析，该分析将目标瓦片内的四个 1 km × 1 km 单元格分别归入三个类别之一：低收入且低可达、低可达或非低可达。 详细的任务设置见 D.1 和 D.3.1。

paragraphs.en: We fine-tune and evaluate four multimodal models on AgenticCity-Bench: MODUS (7B) Ye et al. (2026) , UniGen (Qwen2.5-1.5B backbone) Tian et al. (2026) , 4M-21-XL (3B) Mizrahi et al. (2023) , Show-o2 (1.5B) Xie et al. (2025) . All baselines are fine-tuned end-to-end from their released checkpoints. We update the full backbone, and no additional urban-specific adapter is introduced. As shown in Table 14 , the dataset contains more than 28 million possible samples. We select 269,472 samples and split them into training, validation, and test sets with 172,032, 48,720, and 48,720 samples, respectively.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在 AgenticCity-Bench 上微调并评估四个多模态模型：MODUS (7B)（Ye 等） （2026）、UniGen（Qwen2.5-1.5B 主干）（Tian 等） （2026）、4M-21-XL (3B)（Mizrahi 等） （2023）、Show-o2 (1.5B)（Xie 等，2025）。 所有基线模型均从其发布的检查点进行端到端微调。 我们更新完整的主干网络，且不引入任何额外的城市专用适配器。 如表 14 所示，该数据集包含超过 2800 万个可能的样本。 我们选取 269,472 个样本，并将其划分为训练集、验证集和测试集，分别包含 172,032、48,720 和 48,720 个样本。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate frontier general agents OpenCode ( OpenCode Contributors, 2026 ) and Codex CLI ( OpenAI, 2026a ) , alongside domain-specific Earth Agent ( Feng et al., 2026b ) . The task model configurations use GPT-5.6 Luna and GPT-5.6 Terra ( OpenAI, 2026c ; OpenAI, 2026d ) , GPT-5.5 ( OpenAI, 2026b ) , DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash ( DeepSeek-AI, 2026 ; Guo et al., 2025 ) , and Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite ( Google, 2026 ) ; within each task, configurations share the selected cases and allowed observation scope. The EV charger, school capacity planning, and food access experiments expose the same task-specific tools across their respective agent configurations, and the forecasting experiments compare Earth Agent’s analytical tools with the native tools of OpenCode and Codex.
paragraphs.zh: 我们评估了前沿通用智能体 OpenCode（OpenCode Contributors, 2026）和 Codex CLI（OpenAI, 2026a），以及领域专用的 Earth Agent（Feng et al., 2026b）。 任务模型配置使用 GPT-5.6 Luna 和 GPT-5.6 Terra（OpenAI, 2026c；OpenAI, 2026d）、GPT-5.5（OpenAI, 2026b）、DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash（DeepSeek-AI, 2026；Guo et al., 2025）以及 Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite（Google, 2026）；在每个任务内，各配置共享所选案例和允许的观测范围。 电动车充电桩、学校容量规划和食物可及性实验在其各自的智能体配置间暴露相同的任务专用工具，而预测实验则将 Earth Agent 的分析工具与 OpenCode 和 Codex 的原生工具进行比较。

paragraphs.en: Our agentic task comprises 1,000 cases spanning forecasting, urban planning, and resource analysis. Forecasting includes 220 land surface temperature, 220 carbon emission, and 160 property-price cases across 15, 16, and 8 cities, respectively. These cover 120 tile–target pairs across 106 distinct 2 ​ km × 2 ​ km 2\,\mathrm{km}\times 2\,\mathrm{km} tiles, with annual forecast origins in 2020–2024 and rolling ten-year observation windows spanning 2010–2023. Planning includes 150 EV charger location cases and 100 school capacity cases. EV cases cover 50 tiles each in Boston, New York City, and San Francisco, predicting net charging port growth from September 2024 to September 2026. School cases cover 100 London schools in distinct tiles (60 primary and 40 secondary), using enrollment and capacity histories from academic years 2021/22–2023/24 to plan additional seats for 2024/25. The sample contains 50 balanced and 50 shortage cases under target-year utilization without expansion. Resource analysis comprises 150 food access cases using 2019 reference labels: 38 each in Boston and Washington, D.C., and 37 each in New York City and San Francisco. Each tile contains four 1 ​ km × 1 ​ km 1\,\mathrm{km}\times 1\,\mathrm{km} cells, yielding 600 cell-level assessments.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的智能体任务包含1,000个案例，涵盖预测、城市规划和资源分析。 预测任务包括220个地表温度案例、220个碳排放案例和160个房价案例，分别横跨15个城市、16个城市和8个城市。 这些案例涵盖106个不同的2 km × 2 km瓦片中的120个瓦片–目标对，预测起点分布在2020–2024年，滚动十年观测窗口横跨2010–2023年。 规划任务包括150个电动汽车充电桩选址案例和100个学校容量案例。 电动汽车案例覆盖波士顿、纽约市和旧金山各50个瓦片，预测2024年9月至2026年9月期间充电端口的净增长。 学校案例覆盖100所位于不同瓦片的伦敦学校（60所小学和40所中学），利用2021/22–2023/24学年的入学人数和容量历史，为2024/25学年规划新增学位。 该样本在不扩建的目标学年利用率条件下，包含50个均衡案例和50个短缺案例。 资源分析包括150个使用2019年参考标签的食物可达性案例：波士顿和华盛顿特区各38个，纽约市和旧金山各37个。 每个瓦片包含四个1 km × 1 km网格，共产生600个网格层面的评估。

paragraphs.en: The forecasting evaluation includes seven configurations: Earth Agent with GPT Luna and DeepSeek, Codex with GPT-5.5 and DeepSeek, and OpenCode with GPT Luna, Gemini, and GLM. Both use the corresponding official API, a temperature of 0.1, and a requested reasoning-effort setting of low. Each added configuration evaluates the same 600 cases, comprising 220 LST, 220 carbon-emission, and 160 property-price cases. Task instructions, native tools, and case identities follow the corresponding forecasting protocol. Available observations from periods − 10 -10 through − 1 -1 are accessible for every modality, with coverage determined by each data source. Target-period outcomes remain held out for all cases.

paragraphs.en: Tables 2 and 3 evaluate translation between any two modalities and provide representative cross-model comparisons. Three main findings follow. (1) Any-to-any translation reveals cross-modal complementarity and translation relationships. This task provides a way to examine how information in one modality can support the generation of another. For example, Table 2 shows that activity modalities such as population, electricity, nighttime lights, GPS density, and carbon emissions perform well on several numerical-to-numerical translations. Population yields better generation results for electricity than continuous visual features such as the road network. (2) Cross-modal translation is directionally asymmetric. Translation performance varies by direction. Visual inputs can predict numerical targets, but numerical inputs are less effective at recovering spatial structure. In Fig. 6 , numerical inputs can generate plausible images and land-cover maps, but their spatial layouts may differ from the ground truth. (3) Joint any-to-any training is uneven across modalities. Although optical imagery and road maps both capture urban spatial structures, their visual characteristics differ substantially. In Fig 3 , the jointly trained model can generate spatially plausible optical imagery but struggles to generate coherent road networks. In Table 3 , different models perform better on different tasks rather than showing consistent performance across modalities.
paragraphs.zh: 表2和表3评估了任意两种模态之间的翻译，并提供了具有代表性的跨模型比较。 由此得出三个主要发现。 (1) 任意到任意的翻译揭示了跨模态互补性与翻译关系。 该任务提供了一种考察一个模态中的信息如何支持另一个模态生成的方式。 例如，表2显示，人口、电力、夜间灯光、GPS密度和碳排放等活动模态在若干数值到数值的翻译任务上表现良好。 相比道路网络等连续视觉特征，人口模态能为电力生成更好的结果。 (2) 跨模态翻译具有方向上的不对称性。 翻译性能因方向而异。 视觉输入可以预测数值目标，但数值输入在恢复空间结构方面效果较差。 在图6中，数值输入可以生成看似合理的图像和土地覆盖图，但其空间布局可能与真值不同。 (3) 任意到任意的联合训练在各模态间并不均衡。 尽管光学影像和道路地图都刻画了城市空间结构，但它们的视觉特征差异显著。 在图3中，联合训练的模型能够生成空间上看似合理的光学影像，但难以生成连贯的道路网络。 在表3中，不同模型在不同任务上表现更佳，而非在各模态间保持一致的表现。

sents.en: Tables 2 and 3 evaluate translation between any two modalities and provide representative cross-model comparisons.
sents.zh: 表2和表3评估了任意两种模态之间的翻译，并提供了具有代表性的跨模型比较。

sents.en: Three main findings follow.
sents.zh: 由此得出三个主要发现。

sents.en: (1) Any-to-any translation reveals cross-modal complementarity and translation relationships.
sents.zh: (1) 任意到任意的翻译揭示了跨模态互补性与翻译关系。

sents.en: This task provides a way to examine how information in one modality can support the generation of another.
sents.zh: 该任务提供了一种考察一个模态中的信息如何支持另一个模态生成的方式。

sents.en: For example, Table 2 shows that activity modalities such as population, electricity, nighttime lights, GPS density, and carbon emissions perform well on several numerical-to-numerical translations.
sents.zh: 例如，表2显示，人口、电力、夜间灯光、GPS密度和碳排放等活动模态在若干数值到数值的翻译任务上表现良好。

sents.en: Population yields better generation results for electricity than continuous visual features such as the road network.
sents.zh: 相比道路网络等连续视觉特征，人口模态能为电力生成更好的结果。

sents.en: (2) Cross-modal translation is directionally asymmetric.
sents.zh: (2) 跨模态翻译具有方向上的不对称性。

sents.en: Translation performance varies by direction.
sents.zh: 翻译性能因方向而异。

sents.en: Visual inputs can predict numerical targets, but numerical inputs are less effective at recovering spatial structure.
sents.zh: 视觉输入可以预测数值目标，但数值输入在恢复空间结构方面效果较差。

sents.en: In Fig. 6 , numerical inputs can generate plausible images and land-cover maps, but their spatial layouts may differ from the ground truth.
sents.zh: 在图6中，数值输入可以生成看似合理的图像和土地覆盖图，但其空间布局可能与真值不同。

sents.en: (3) Joint any-to-any training is uneven across modalities.
sents.zh: (3) 任意到任意的联合训练在各模态间并不均衡。

sents.en: Although optical imagery and road maps both capture urban spatial structures, their visual characteristics differ substantially.
sents.zh: 尽管光学影像和道路地图都刻画了城市空间结构，但它们的视觉特征差异显著。

sents.en: In Fig 3 , the jointly trained model can generate spatially plausible optical imagery but struggles to generate coherent road networks.
sents.zh: 在图3中，联合训练的模型能够生成空间上看似合理的光学影像，但难以生成连贯的道路网络。

sents.en: In Table 3 , different models perform better on different tasks rather than showing consistent performance across modalities.
sents.zh: 在表3中，不同模型在不同任务上表现更佳，而非在各模态间保持一致的表现。

paragraphs.en: In summary, these results highlight that cross-modal translation offers a way to further explore relationships among modalities, while pointing to the need for stronger modality-aware optimization and joint-training strategies.
paragraphs.zh: 总之，这些结果突显了跨模态翻译为进一步探索各模态之间的关系提供了一种途径，同时也表明需要更强的模态感知优化和联合训练策略。

paragraphs.en: Table 4 compares agent forecasts and historical baselines across 600 cases. Three main findings follow. (1) Agents improve carbon forecasts while consulting multimodal data. Across the five agent configurations, carbon emission MAE decreases by a median of 112.08 tonnes C/tile/year relative to the last-year baseline, a 17.334% reduction. Tool execution records show that agents use statistical machine learning tools to interpret target history trends and, in some cases, incorporate other urban modalities and indicators (e.g., nighttime lights and satellite imagery) to refine the final estimate (Appendix case 17 and 18 ). (2) Historical averaging remains effective for LST. The ten-year mean outperforms all evaluated agents, suggesting that multi-year averaging captures persistent local thermal conditions while smoothing annual fluctuations. Agents do not consistently adapt their forecasting strategies to these temporal differences: carbon emissions may require greater emphasis on recent activity-related changes, whereas LST may benefit more from long-term historical patterns. (3) Multimodal reasoning does not consistently translate into forecast adjustments in complex tasks. According to the error analysis, we find that agents can identify relevant urban context, but often use it to check or justify a historical estimate rather than quantitatively revise their answer. The inspected cases reveal a gap between interpreting additional modalities and using them to calibrate forecasts (Appendix D.3.2 ).
paragraphs.zh: 表4比较了智能体预测与历史基线在600个案例中的表现。 由此得出三项主要发现。 （1）智能体在参考多模态数据的情况下改进了碳排放预测。 在五种智能体配置中，碳排放MAE相对于去年基线的中位数下降为112.08吨碳/瓦片/年，降幅为17.334%。 工具执行记录显示，智能体使用统计机器学习工具来解读目标历史趋势，并且在某些情况下纳入其他城市模态和指标（如夜间灯光和卫星影像）来完善最终估计值（附录案例17和18）。 （2）历史平均法对地表温度（LST）仍然有效。 十年均值优于所有被评估的智能体，表明多年平均能够捕捉持续的局地热状况，同时平滑年度波动。 智能体并未一致地使其预测策略适应这些时间差异：碳排放可能需要更加关注近期与活动相关的变化，而地表温度则可能更多地受益于长期历史模式。 （3）多模态推理并不必然转化为复杂任务中的预测调整。 根据误差分析，我们发现智能体能够识别相关的城市背景信息，但往往只是用它来核对或佐证历史估计值，而不是定量地修正其答案。 所检视的案例揭示了解读额外模态与利用它们校准预测之间的差距（附录D.3.2）。

paragraphs.en: Figure 4 illustrates modality usage by Codex (DeepSeek) across three forecasting tasks. For LST, frequent access to weather data and optical imagery is consistent with the influence of climatic conditions and surface characteristics on temperature, while vegetation and built form provide complementary information about cooling and heat retention, respectively. For carbon emissions, the agent accesses energy-use rasters more frequently, indicating attention to emission-related activity. Nighttime lights and population provide indirect proxies whose relationship with emissions depends on energy intensity and the composition of emission sources. For property prices, the agent accesses population, economic indicators, and built volume, covering potential demand and supply signals. Overall, the figure shows that the agent selects different evidence according to the task. Future agents could better exploit multimodal information and improve forecasting by moving beyond identifying relevant modalities toward reasoning about their complementary, overlapping, or offsetting effects and translating these relationships into quantitative adjustments.
paragraphs.zh: 图4展示了Codex（DeepSeek）在三个预测任务中的模态使用情况。 对于地表温度（LST），频繁访问气象数据和光学影像与气候条件及地表特征对温度的影响相一致，而植被和建筑形态分别提供了关于降温与保温的补充信息。 对于碳排放，智能体更频繁地访问能源使用栅格数据，表明其对排放相关活动的关注。 夜间灯光和人口提供的是间接代理指标，它们与排放的关系取决于能源强度和排放源的构成。 对于房价，智能体访问人口、经济指标和建筑体量数据，涵盖了潜在的供需信号。 总体而言，该图表明智能体会根据任务选择不同的证据。 未来的智能体可以更好地利用多模态信息，超越识别相关模态的阶段，进而推理各模态之间互补、重叠或抵消的效应，并将这些关系转化为定量调整，从而改进预测。

paragraphs.en: Table 5 summarizes both planning tasks. For EV charger expansion planning, agents outperform the constant-class baseline by up to 16.7 percentage points in accuracy. Successful cases combine multimodal data such as population and POI with charging histories to support decisions (Table 32 ). However, agents often underestimate the real requirement due to focusing too much on the historical trend instead of considering the increasing need for EV facilities as cities develop. For school capacity planning, agents improve balance rate over the three-year average baseline by up to 5 percentage points in balance rate, showing the agent’s ability to translate recent enrollment trends into capacity adjustments. Incorporating more domain-specific knowledge (e.g., age structure) has the potential to improve agents’ task-specific ability ( Department for Education, 2026 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 表5总结了两个规划任务。 在电动汽车充电桩扩建规划中，智能体的准确率比常类别基线最高高出16.7个百分点。 成功案例将人口、POI等多模态数据与充电历史相结合以支持决策（表32）。 然而，智能体往往低估实际需求，因为它们过于关注历史趋势，而没有考虑随着城市发展对电动汽车设施日益增长的需求。 在学校容量规划中，智能体的均衡率比三年平均基线最高提高5个百分点，展示了智能体将近期入学趋势转化为容量调整的能力。 引入更多领域特定知识（如年龄结构）有望提升智能体在特定任务上的能力（教育部，2026）。

paragraphs.en: Table 6 reports performance on 150 food-access analysis cases, each containing four spatial cells’ prediction. Codex (DeepSeek) achieves the highest macro-F1, but its exact-case accuracy remains low, mainly due to difficulty in correctly resolving all four cells within a case. Identifying joint low-income and low-access areas also remains challenging for some configurations. For example, Gemini correctly identifies only 2 of 62 such cells. Inspected agent rationales show that commercial activity is sometimes treated as evidence of supermarket accessibility, overlooking differences between general urban activity and access to specific services. These cases highlight limitations in interpreting modality semantics and spatial scale. More effective multimodal reasoning requires distinguishing direct evidence from indirect proxies and checking whether their spatial coverage supports the requested judgments.
paragraphs.zh: 表6报告了150个食品获取分析案例上的性能，每个案例包含四个空间单元的预测。 Codex（DeepSeek）取得了最高的宏F1，但其整例准确率仍然较低，主要原因是难以正确解析一个案例中的全部四个单元。 对于某些配置而言，识别低收入与低获取并存的区域也仍然具有挑战性。 例如，Gemini在62个此类单元中仅正确识别了2个。 对智能体推理依据的检查显示，商业活动有时被当作超市可达性的证据，这忽略了一般城市活动与获取特定服务之间的差异。 这些案例凸显了在解读模态语义与空间尺度方面的局限性。 更有效的多模态推理需要区分直接证据与间接代理指标，并检验其空间覆盖范围是否支持所要求的判断。

paragraphs.en: Tool-use traces show that Earth Agent relies more on specialized statistical and machine-learning tools for forecasting, while Codex and OpenCode primarily analyze data through code (Appendix D.4.1 ). More tool calls do not consistently correspond to better performance. For example, in food-access analysis, Earth Agent (DeepSeek) averages 28.520 calls per case, compared with 12.907 for Codex (GPT-5.5), yet achieves lower macro-F1 (0.385 versus 0.475) and exact-case accuracy (14.7% versus 37.3%). The inspected cases illustrate how historical window selection, capacity margins, and spatial interpretation shape the final decisions. These observations highlight the importance of how agents interpret and apply retrieved evidence, beyond the volume of tool use.
paragraphs.zh: 工具使用轨迹显示，Earth Agent 在预测方面更多依赖专门的统计和机器学习工具，而 Codex 和 OpenCode 主要通过代码来分析数据（附录 D.4.1）。 更多的工具调用并不总是对应更好的性能。 例如，在食物可达性分析中，Earth Agent（DeepSeek）平均每个案例调用 28.520 次，而 Codex（GPT-5.5）为 12.907 次，但前者的宏平均 F1（0.385 对 0.475）和整例准确率（14.7% 对 37.3%）反而更低。 所检查的案例说明了历史窗口选择、容量余量和空间解读如何影响最终决策。 这些观察凸显了智能体如何解读和应用检索到的证据的重要性，而不仅仅是工具使用的数量。

sents.en: These observations highlight the importance of how agents interpret and apply retrieved evidence, beyond the volume of tool use.
sents.zh: 这些观察凸显了智能体如何解读和应用检索到的证据的重要性，而不仅仅是工具使用的数量。

paragraphs.en: We present AgenticCity-Bench, a dataset that integrates 18 urban modalities across 16 cities from 2000 to 2025. It provides a foundation for research on urban understanding and agentic analysis. Our experiments demonstrate the potential for cross-modal translation of urban data, while highlighting the need to better balance different modalities. We further evaluate six agentic city tasks across three categories with 1,000 cases and identify both promising capabilities and persistent limitations. The gap between understanding and action, insufficient domain knowledge, and improper tool use can be improved in the future. Researchers can build on our dataset and benchmark to develop more effective urban foundation models and urban agents to provide suggestions to policymakers and advance the development of urban science and the Earth domain.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出 AgenticCity-Bench，这是一个整合了 2000 年至 2025 年间 16 个城市 18 种城市模态的数据集。 它为城市理解与智能体分析的研究提供了基础。 我们的实验展示了城市数据跨模态转换的潜力，同时也凸显了更好平衡不同模态的必要性。 我们进一步在三大类别上评估了六项智能体城市任务，共包含 1,000 个案例，并识别出有前景的能力与持续存在的局限。 理解与行动之间的差距、领域知识不足以及工具使用不当等问题有望在未来得到改进。 研究者可以在我们的数据集和基准之上，开发更有效的城市基础模型与城市智能体，为政策制定者提供建议，并推动城市科学与地球领域的发展。

paragraphs.en: Research on EO and urban benchmarks can be organized around three complementary goals: learning from annotated scenes, transferring across heterogeneous observations, and understanding urban conditions across modalities and time ( Xia et al., 2018 ; Nedungadi et al., 2024 ; Xuan et al., 2025 ; Feng et al., 2025b ) . Early task-focused resources established reusable supervision: DOTA provided oriented object annotations for aerial detection, while RSVQA paired remotely sensed imagery with natural-language questions and answers ( Xia et al., 2018 ; Lobry et al., 2020 ) . Subsequent resources broadened both training and evaluation, with geographically aligned multimodal pretraining data and curated task suites for assessing transferable representations ( Nedungadi et al., 2024 ; Lacoste et al., 2023 ) . Temporal benchmarks introduced a different axis of coverage, progressing from monthly building tracking to multi-year analyses of urban transformation ( Van Etten et al., 2021 ; Xuan et al., 2025 ) . In parallel, urban data pipelines and instruction benchmarks have connected imagery with structured geospatial and mobility data, extending evaluation beyond surface appearance to cross-modal urban understanding ( Wang et al., 2024 ; Feng et al., 2025b ) .
paragraphs.zh: 关于EO与城市基准的研究可以围绕三个互补目标展开：从带标注的场景中学习、在异构观测之间进行迁移，以及跨模态和跨时间地理解城市状况（Xia等，2018；Nedungadi等，2024；Xuan等，2025；Feng等，2025b）。 早期的面向任务的资源建立了可复用的监督信号：DOTA为航拍检测提供了带方向的目标标注，而RSVQA则将遥感影像与自然语言问答配对（Xia等，2018；Lobry等，2020）。 后续的资源在训练和评测两方面都进行了拓展，包括地理对齐的多模态预训练数据，以及用于评估可迁移表示的精选任务套件（Nedungadi等，2024；Lacoste等，2023）。 时序基准引入了另一个覆盖维度，从逐月的建筑追踪发展到对城市变化的多年度分析（Van Etten等，2021；Xuan等，2025）。 与此同时，城市数据流水线和指令基准将影像与结构化的地理空间和出行数据连接起来，使评测从表观特征延伸到跨模态的城市理解（Wang等，2024；Feng等，2025b）。

Generative EO models can synthesize missing modalities from available observations, but integrating environmental observations with urban activity records over time remains challenging ( Jakubik et al., 2025 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 这些进展凸显了跨模态、跨时间联合建模异构城市数据的挑战 ( Wang et al., 2024 ; Feng et al., 2025b ; Xuan et al., 2025 ) 。 生成式对地观测（EO）模型可以从可用的观测中合成缺失的模态，但随着时间推移将环境观测与城市活动记录整合起来仍然具有挑战性 ( Jakubik et al., 2025 ) 。

paragraphs.en: Agentic geospatial research brings together simulation-based decision environments, language-guided analytical workflows, and increasingly process-aware evaluation ( Zhang et al., 2019 ; Akinboyewa et al., 2025 ; Feng et al., 2026a ; Lai et al., 2026 ) . Before the rise of LLM agents, CityFlow already provided a large-scale traffic simulation environment and interfaces for multi-agent reinforcement learning, establishing an action-and-feedback setting for urban control ( Zhang et al., 2019 ) . In the broader language-agent literature, ReAct subsequently articulated how interleaving reasoning with actions allows models to obtain external information and update their plans ( Yao et al., 2023 ) . Domain-specific agentic systems have adapted these capabilities to GIS workflow generation, multimodal scientific analysis, and the coordination of retrieval, perception, and reasoning tools ( Akinboyewa et al., 2025 ; Feng et al., 2026a ; Xiao et al., 2026 ) . Urban evaluation has developed alongside this analytical strand: CityBench combines heterogeneous city data with interactive simulation, while USTBench diagnoses understanding, forecasting, planning, and reflection within urban tasks ( Feng et al., 2025c ; Lai et al., 2026 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 智能体化地理空间研究将基于仿真的决策环境、语言引导的分析工作流，以及日益具备过程感知能力的评估结合在一起（Zhang et al., 2019；Akinboyewa et al., 2025；Feng et al., 2026a；Lai et al., 2026）。 在大语言模型智能体兴起之前，CityFlow 已经提供了大规模交通仿真环境以及面向多智能体强化学习的接口，为城市控制确立了动作与反馈的设定（Zhang et al., 2019）。 在更广泛的语言智能体文献中，ReAct 随后阐明了将推理与动作交错进行如何使模型获取外部信息并更新其计划（Yao et al., 2023）。 面向特定领域的智能体系统已将这些能力应用于 GIS 工作流生成、多模态科学分析，以及检索、感知与推理工具的协调（Akinboyewa et al., 2025；Feng et al., 2026a；Xiao et al., 2026）。 城市评估与这一分析方向并行发展：CityBench 将异构城市数据与交互式仿真相结合，而 USTBench 则在城市任务中诊断理解、预测、规划与反思能力（Feng et al., 2025c；Lai et al., 2026）。

sents.en: Agentic geospatial research brings together simulation-based decision environments, language-guided analytical workflows, and increasingly process-aware evaluation ( Zhang et al., 2019 ; Akinboyewa et al., 2025 ; Feng et al., 2026a ; Lai et al., 2026 ) .

sents.zh: 城市评估与这一分析方向并行发展：CityBench 将异构城市数据与交互式仿真相结合，而 USTBench 则在城市任务中诊断理解、预测、规划与反思能力（Feng et al., 2025c；Lai et al., 2026）。

paragraphs.en: These developments make it possible to examine how agents reach their results ( Feng et al., 2026a ; Lai et al., 2026 ) . However, failures in tool use, domain-specific reasoning, and long-horizon adaptation show that successful perception does not guarantee reliable analysis or decision-making ( Feng et al., 2026a ; Xiao et al., 2026 ; Lai et al., 2026 ) . Agents must therefore select relevant information, identify missing prerequisites, and construct spatial plans under explicit constraints.
paragraphs.zh: 这些进展使得考察智能体如何得出其结果成为可能 ( Feng et al., 2026a ; Lai et al., 2026 ) 。 然而，工具使用、领域特定推理以及长程适应方面的失败表明，成功的感知并不能保证可靠的分析或决策 ( Feng et al., 2026a ; Xiao et al., 2026 ; Lai et al., 2026 ) 。 因此，智能体必须在明确约束下选择相关信息、识别缺失的前提条件并构建空间规划。

paragraphs.en: The benchmark covers 16 city-centered regions selected to span six inhabited continents and different urban forms, climates, and data environments. Each region is projected to a local metric coordinate reference system before tiling. Separate, non-overlapping grids are constructed at 2-km and 5-km scales; the 5-km grid is not produced by aggregating the 2-km grid. A tile is identified by city, scale, row, and column, which provides a stable spatial key for joining heterogeneous sources without implying that their native resolutions are identical. Table 7 reports the projected grid geometry and the number of tiles retained at each scale.
paragraphs.zh: 该基准覆盖了16个以城市为中心的区域，这些区域的选取横跨六个有人居住的大陆以及不同的城市形态、气候和数据环境。 每个区域在切片之前都会被投影到当地公制坐标参考系中。 分别在2公里和5公里尺度上构建互不重叠的网格；5公里网格并非通过聚合2公里网格生成。 每个瓦片由城市、尺度、行和列标识，这为连接异构数据源提供了稳定的空间键，同时不意味着它们的原生分辨率完全相同。 表7报告了投影后的网格几何信息以及每个尺度下保留的瓦片数量。

paragraphs.en: Across the 16 cities and 26 years from 2000 to 2025, the dataset includes 18 modalities for the any-to-any translation tasks, indexed by city, year, and modality. In addition, a grid-context modality is provided only during training to supply spatial background information and is not used as a source or target in the translation tasks. The grid context is available for all cities and is therefore excluded from the modality coverage analysis. Static and epoch-based data are reused across the corresponding years when applicable, rather than being treated as independent annual observations. For the 18 translation modalities, there are 16 × 26 × 18 = 7,488 16\times 26\times 18=7{,}488 possible city, year, and modality combinations in Table 10 . Among these, 6,309 combinations are available, corresponding to an overall availability rate of 84.3%. The main gaps arise from electricity, property, air quality, GPS, POI, and historical road-network records in Fig 5 .
paragraphs.zh: 在2000年至2025年的26年间、覆盖16个城市，该数据集包含18种模态，用于任意到任意的翻译任务，并按城市、年份和模态进行索引。 此外，提供了一种仅在训练阶段使用的网格上下文模态，用于提供空间背景信息，并且在翻译任务中不作为源或目标使用。 网格上下文对所有城市均可用，因此在模态覆盖分析中被排除。 静态数据和按年代（epoch）划分的数据在适用的情况下会在相应年份间重复使用，而不是被视为独立的年度观测数据。 对于这18种翻译模态，表10中共有 16 × 26 × 18 = 7,488 16\times 26\times 18=7{,}488 种可能的城市、年份和模态组合。 其中，有6,309个组合可用，对应84.3%的总体可用率。 如图5所示，主要的缺失来自电力、房产、空气质量、GPS、POI以及历史路网记录。

paragraphs.en: Data availability is also determined using finite-value checks, data-specific no-data values, and coverage masks when available. Image modalities require at least 98% valid pixels, while numerical modalities require valid source support above a predefined threshold. If a modality does not meet these criteria, it is marked as unavailable for the corresponding city, year, tile combination.
paragraphs.zh: 数据可用性还通过有限值检查、特定数据的无数据值以及覆盖掩膜（在可用时）来确定。 图像模态要求至少有 98% 的有效像素，而数值模态要求有效源支持度高于预定义的阈值。 如果某个模态不满足这些标准，则该模态会被标记为对应的城市、年份、瓦片组合不可用。

sents.en: If a modality does not meet these criteria, it is marked as unavailable for the corresponding city, year, tile combination.
sents.zh: 如果某个模态不满足这些标准，则该模态会被标记为对应的城市、年份、瓦片组合不可用。

paragraphs.en: Missing observations are represented using explicit availability masks and are neither zero-filled nor replaced with synthetic observations. For example, the electricity data for Washington DC do not cover the surrounding areas and suburbs. Tiles outside the reported coverage are therefore marked as unavailable rather than assigned zero consumption. Conversely, zero is retained when it represents a meaningful observation, including no road in road network , ocean in Land Use, and physical zeros in continuous fields.
paragraphs.zh: 缺失观测使用显式的可用性掩码来表示，既不进行零填充，也不用人造观测值替换。 例如，华盛顿特区的电力数据并不覆盖周边地区和郊区。 因此，超出报告覆盖范围的图块被标记为不可用，而不是被赋予零消耗。 相反，当零代表有意义的观测时会予以保留，包括道路网络中无道路、土地利用中的海洋，以及连续字段中的物理零值。

paragraphs.en: In Table 12 , we use band 1 of the supplied OSM raster as the road layer. Nonzero pixels are rendered in a fixed red RGB value ( 224 , 64 , 69 ) (224,64,69) on a white background. Zero pixels indicate no mapped road and remain valid. Therefore, a tile without mapped roads can still meet the 98% validity threshold. The release converter does not add road buffers, dilate road lines, or create new road pixels. Each raster keeps the year or snapshot provided with the original OSM data. A blank road image indicates that no roads are mapped in the supplied data, not that the area has no roads in reality.
paragraphs.zh: 在表 12 中，我们使用所提供 OSM 栅格的第 1 波段作为道路图层。 非零像素在白色背景上以固定的红色 RGB 值 (224, 64, 69) (224,64,69) 渲染。 零像素表示没有已绘制的道路，并且仍然有效。 因此，没有已绘制道路的瓦片仍可满足 98% 的有效性阈值。 发布转换器不会添加道路缓冲区、膨胀道路线条或创建新的道路像素。 每个栅格都保留原始 OSM 数据所附带的年份或快照。 空白的道路图像表示所提供的数据中没有绘制道路，而不是该区域在现实中没有道路。

sents.zh: 在表 12 中，我们使用所提供 OSM 栅格的第 1 波段作为道路图层。

paragraphs.en: In Table 12 , band 1 of BuildingHeight_3DGloBFP provides building height in metres. We treat it as static built-environment information, even when the same data appear in multiple year directories. Valid zero values are retained, and an image is included only when at least 98% of its pixels are valid. Heights are mapped linearly to a fixed grayscale range and replicated across the three RGB channels, then saved as a PNG image. The raster encodes height values, including zero-height pixels, rather than providing a separate binary building-footprint layer. The spatial pattern of nonzero pixels may therefore show where buildings are present, but these pixels are not extracted or converted into a separate footprint layer. The PNG preserves the relative height values within the display range, but may lose the precision and extreme values of the original floating-point data.
paragraphs.zh: 在表12中，BuildingHeight_3DGloBFP 的波段1以米为单位提供建筑高度。 我们将其视为静态建成环境信息，即使相同数据出现在多个年份目录中也是如此。 有效的零值被保留，只有当图像至少98%的像素有效时才会包含该图像。 高度被线性映射到固定的灰度范围并复制到三个 RGB 通道，然后保存为 PNG 图像。 该栅格编码高度值（包括零高度像素），而不是提供单独的二进制建筑轮廓图层。 因此，非零像素的空间分布可能显示建筑物所在的位置，但这些像素并未被提取或转换为单独的轮廓图层。 PNG 保留了显示范围内的相对高度值，但可能会损失原始浮点数据的精度和极端值。

paragraphs.en: Built volume (GHSL) is provided as 5-year epoch data. We use band 1, which in Table 12 represents total built-volume density in m 3 /m 2 , and exclude the non-residential band. Zero values are valid and indicate no built volume, while the explicit − 9999 -9999 value is treated as invalid. After applying the 98% validity filter, we apply a log transform and map the values to a fixed percentile-based grayscale range to produce a PNG image. We use the spatial grid provided in the original GHSL data without additional spatial reconstruction or resampling. According to previous works ( Tesselaar et al., 2023 ; Yu et al., 2022 ) , each 5-year epoch value is reused for the years covered by that epoch and does not represent separate yearly observations.
paragraphs.zh: 建筑体量（GHSL）以 5 年期数据的形式提供。 我们使用波段 1，即表 12 中表示以 m 3 /m 2 为单位的总建筑体量密度的波段，并排除非住宅波段。 零值是有效值，表示没有建筑体量，而显式的 − 9999 -9999 值被视为无效。 在应用 98% 有效性过滤后，我们对数值进行对数变换，并将其映射到固定的基于百分位的灰度范围，以生成 PNG 图像。 我们使用原始 GHSL 数据中提供的空间网格，不进行额外的空间重建或重采样。 根据以往的研究（ Tesselaar et al., 2023 ； Yu et al., 2022 ），每个 5 年期的数值会被重复用于该 5 年期所覆盖的年份，并不代表独立的逐年观测值。

paragraphs.en: In Table 12 , band 1 of LU (HILDA) provides categorical land-use IDs. The fixed legend includes ocean, urban land, crop systems, pasture, forest types, unmanaged grass or shrubland, sparse vegetation, and inland water. ID 0 is valid and represents ocean, while ID 99 represents nodata. IDs outside the defined classes are treated as invalid. Images are included only when at least 98% of the pixels are valid and are saved as a PNG image. The class IDs represent discrete categories rather than continuous values, so we use a fixed RGB lookup table instead of continuous interpolation. During generation, each predicted pixel is mapped to the class with the nearest predefined class color.
paragraphs.zh: 在表 12 中，LU (HILDA) 的波段 1 提供分类土地利用 ID。 固定图例包括海洋、城市用地、作物系统、牧场、森林类型、未管理草地或灌丛、稀疏植被以及内陆水体。 ID 0 是有效值，表示海洋，而 ID 99 表示无数据（nodata）。 超出已定义类别的 ID 被视为无效。 只有当至少 98% 的像素有效时，图像才会被纳入，并保存为 PNG 图像。 类别 ID 表示离散类别而非连续值，因此我们使用固定的 RGB 查找表而不是连续插值。 在生成过程中，每个预测像素被映射到与预定义类别颜色最近邻的类别。

paragraphs.en: POI refers to OSM-derived points of interest and building-function categories rasterized to the study grid. In Table 12 , band 1 of POI is a 13-class building-function raster. ID 0 denotes outside/no building, while ID 1 denotes an unlabeled building. IDs 2–12 represent residential, commercial/retail/office, education, healthcare, food service, civic/public, transport/parking, tourism/leisure, industrial/warehouse, religious, and other functions. Both 0 and 1 are valid classes, not missing data. The converter uses the supplied rasterized footprint/function map, applies the 98% valid-pixel threshold, and writes a PNG image using a fixed class palette. It does not reclip polygons or infer labels for unlabeled buildings. Temporal meaning follows the supplied OSM snapshot, and the absence of a class is distinct from missing map data. During generation, each predicted pixel is mapped to the class with the nearest predefined class color.
paragraphs.zh: POI 指源自 OSM 的兴趣点及建筑功能类别，并被栅格化到研究网格上。 在表 12 中，POI 的波段 1 是一个包含 13 类建筑功能的栅格。 ID 0 表示建筑物外部/无建筑物，而 ID 1 表示未标注的建筑物。 ID 2–12 分别代表居住、商业/零售/办公、教育、医疗、餐饮、市政/公共、交通/停车、旅游/休闲、工业/仓储、宗教以及其他功能。 0 和 1 都是有效类别，而非缺失数据。 转换器使用提供的栅格化轮廓/功能图，应用 98% 有效像素阈值，并使用固定的类别调色板写入 PNG 图像。 它不会重新裁剪多边形，也不会为未标注的建筑物推断标签。 时间含义遵循所提供的 OSM 快照，且类别的缺失不同于地图数据缺失。 在生成过程中，每个预测像素被映射到与其最近似预定义类别颜色的类别。

sents.en: Both 0 and 1 are valid classes, not missing data.
sents.zh: 0 和 1 都是有效类别，而非缺失数据。

sents.en: The converter uses the supplied rasterized footprint/function map, applies the 98% valid-pixel threshold, and writes a PNG image using a fixed class palette.
sents.zh: 转换器使用提供的栅格化轮廓/功能图，应用 98% 有效像素阈值，并使用固定的类别调色板写入 PNG 图像。

sents.en: It does not reclip polygons or infer labels for unlabeled buildings.
sents.zh: 它不会重新裁剪多边形，也不会为未标注的建筑物推断标签。

sents.en: Temporal meaning follows the supplied OSM snapshot, and the absence of a class is distinct from missing map data.
sents.zh: 时间含义遵循所提供的 OSM 快照，且类别的缺失不同于地图数据缺失。

sents.en: During generation, each predicted pixel is mapped to the class with the nearest predefined class color.
sents.zh: 在生成过程中，每个预测像素被映射到与其最近似预定义类别颜色的类别。

paragraphs.en: In Table 12 , land cover uses the original band-1 IDs. A fixed legend retains crop, forest, shrub, grass, wetland, impervious, bare, water, and snow/ice distinctions and maps them to a PNG image. Thus the image also supports analysis of green-space composition. The current legend accepts ID 0 as non-green or unclassified; this must not be interpreted as the road-background class or automatically as verified non-green land. Accepted images require 98% valid pixels. Temporal assignments are inherited; class IDs are not continuously normalized or interpolated. During generation, each predicted pixel is mapped to the class with the nearest predefined class color.
paragraphs.zh: 在表12中，土地覆盖使用原始的波段1 ID。 固定的图例保留农田、森林、灌木、草地、湿地、不透水面、裸地、水体以及冰雪的区分，并将其映射为PNG图像。 因此，该图像也支持绿地构成分析。 当前图例将ID 0视为非绿地或未分类；这不得被解释为道路背景类别，也不得自动视为已核实的非绿地。 被接受的图像需要98%的有效像素。 时间分配是继承的；类别ID不会被持续归一化或插值。 在生成过程中，每个预测像素被映射到预定义类别颜色最接近的类别。

sents.en: In Table 12 , land cover uses the original band-1 IDs.
sents.zh: 在表12中，土地覆盖使用原始的波段1 ID。

sents.en: A fixed legend retains crop, forest, shrub, grass, wetland, impervious, bare, water, and snow/ice distinctions and maps them to a PNG image.
sents.zh: 固定的图例保留农田、森林、灌木、草地、湿地、不透水面、裸地、水体以及冰雪的区分，并将其映射为PNG图像。

sents.en: Thus the image also supports analysis of green-space composition.
sents.zh: 因此，该图像也支持绿地构成分析。

sents.en: The current legend accepts ID 0 as non-green or unclassified; this must not be interpreted as the road-background class or automatically as verified non-green land.
sents.zh: 当前图例将ID 0视为非绿地或未分类；这不得被解释为道路背景类别，也不得自动视为已核实的非绿地。

sents.en: Accepted images require 98% valid pixels.
sents.zh: 被接受的图像需要98%的有效像素。

sents.en: Temporal assignments are inherited; class IDs are not continuously normalized or interpolated.
sents.zh: 时间分配是继承的；类别ID不会被持续归一化或插值。

sents.en: During generation, each predicted pixel is mapped to the class with the nearest predefined class color.
sents.zh: 在生成过程中，每个预测像素被映射到预定义类别颜色最接近的类别。

paragraphs.en: Population (GHSL) provides population density in persons/km 2 . In Table 13 , it provides population density rather than population counts for individual pixels. We use the spatial mean of valid pixels within each tile to obtain the tile-level population density. At least 50% of the cells must be valid, and zero population is retained as a valid value. Population data are provided for specific source epochs, and the same value is reused for the corresponding years in the dataset without additional temporal interpolation ( Yu et al., 2022 ; Tesselaar et al., 2023 ) . A log transform is applied before standardization.
paragraphs.zh: 人口（GHSL）以人/平方公里为单位提供人口密度。 如表 13 所示，它提供的是单个像素的人口密度，而非人口数量。 我们使用每个图块内有效像素的空间均值来获得图块级别的人口密度。 有效像元比例必须至少达到 50%，且零人口被视为有效值予以保留。 人口数据按特定的源时期提供，在数据集中对应的年份直接复用同一数值，不进行额外的时间插值（Yu et al., 2022；Tesselaar et al., 2023）。 在标准化之前先进行对数变换。

sents.en: Population (GHSL) provides population density in persons/km 2 .
sents.zh: 人口（GHSL）以人/平方公里为单位提供人口密度。

sents.en: In Table 13 , it provides population density rather than population counts for individual pixels.
sents.zh: 如表 13 所示，它提供的是单个像素的人口密度，而非人口数量。

sents.en: We use the spatial mean of valid pixels within each tile to obtain the tile-level population density.
sents.zh: 我们使用每个图块内有效像素的空间均值来获得图块级别的人口密度。

sents.en: At least 50% of the cells must be valid, and zero population is retained as a valid value.
sents.zh: 有效像元比例必须至少达到 50%，且零人口被视为有效值予以保留。

sents.en: Population data are provided for specific source epochs, and the same value is reused for the corresponding years in the dataset without additional temporal interpolation ( Yu et al., 2022 ; Tesselaar et al., 2023 ) .
sents.zh: 人口数据按特定的源时期提供，在数据集中对应的年份直接复用同一数值，不进行额外的时间插值（Yu et al., 2022；Tesselaar et al., 2023）。

sents.en: A log transform is applied before standardization.
sents.zh: 在标准化之前先进行对数变换。

paragraphs.en: Property values are obtained from two sources. For most cities, we use the existing property-value datasets listed in Table 8 . For Shanghai and Cape Town, where comparable gridded datasets are unavailable, records are collected from city-specific property websites.
paragraphs.zh: 属性值来自两个来源。 对于大多数城市，我们使用表8中列出的现有属性值数据集。 对于上海和开普敦，由于缺乏可比较的网格化数据集，其记录从城市专属的房地产网站收集。

sents.en: Property values are obtained from two sources.
sents.zh: 属性值来自两个来源。

sents.en: For most cities, we use the existing property-value datasets listed in Table 8 .
sents.zh: 对于大多数城市，我们使用表8中列出的现有属性值数据集。

sents.en: For Shanghai and Cape Town, where comparable gridded datasets are unavailable, records are collected from city-specific property websites.
sents.zh: 对于上海和开普敦，由于缺乏可比较的网格化数据集，其记录从城市专属的房地产网站收集。

paragraphs.en: For existing raster data, we use the mean value. A pixel is valid when it is finite and is not excluded by the source nodata value or raster mask. Let x i x_{i} be the stored value of pixel i i and m i ∈ { 0 , 1 } m_{i}\in\{0,1\} its validity indicator. The valid-support ratio is r valid = ∑ i m i N , r_{\mathrm{valid}}=\frac{\sum_{i}m_{i}}{N}, where N N is the number of pixels in the tile. A tile is retained when r valid ≥ 0.5 r_{\mathrm{valid}}\geq 0.5 , and its property value is computed as x PROP = ∑ i m i ​ x i ∑ i m i . x_{\mathrm{PROP}}=\frac{\sum_{i}m_{i}x_{i}}{\sum_{i}m_{i}}.
paragraphs.zh: 对于现有的栅格数据，我们使用均值。 当一个像素为有限值，且未被源数据 nodata 值或栅格掩膜排除时，该像素为有效。 设 x i x_{i} 为像素 i i 的存储值，m i ∈ { 0 , 1 } m_{i}\in\{0,1\} 为其有效性指示符。 有效支持率为 r valid = ∑ i m i N , r_{\mathrm{valid}}=\frac{\sum_{i}m_{i}}{N},，其中 N N 是该瓦片中的像素数。 当 r valid ≥ 0.5 r_{\mathrm{valid}}\geq 0.5 时该瓦片被保留，其属性值计算为 x PROP = ∑ i m i ​ x i ∑ i m i . x_{\mathrm{PROP}}=\frac{\sum_{i}m_{i}x_{i}}{\sum_{i}m_{i}}.

sents.en: For existing raster data, we use the mean value.
sents.zh: 对于现有的栅格数据，我们使用均值。

sents.en: A pixel is valid when it is finite and is not excluded by the source nodata value or raster mask.
sents.zh: 当一个像素为有限值，且未被源数据 nodata 值或栅格掩膜排除时，该像素为有效。

sents.en: Let x i x_{i} be the stored value of pixel i i and m i ∈ { 0 , 1 } m_{i}\in\{0,1\} its validity indicator.
sents.zh: 设 x i x_{i} 为像素 i i 的存储值，m i ∈ { 0 , 1 } m_{i}\in\{0,1\} 为其有效性指示符。

sents.en: The valid-support ratio is r valid = ∑ i m i N , r_{\mathrm{valid}}=\frac{\sum_{i}m_{i}}{N}, where N N is the number of pixels in the tile.
sents.zh: 有效支持率为 r valid = ∑ i m i N , r_{\mathrm{valid}}=\frac{\sum_{i}m_{i}}{N},，其中 N N 是该瓦片中的像素数。

sents.en: A tile is retained when r valid ≥ 0.5 r_{\mathrm{valid}}\geq 0.5 , and its property value is computed as x PROP = ∑ i m i ​ x i ∑ i m i . x_{\mathrm{PROP}}=\frac{\sum_{i}m_{i}x_{i}}{\sum_{i}m_{i}}.
sents.zh: 当 r valid ≥ 0.5 r_{\mathrm{valid}}\geq 0.5 时该瓦片被保留，其属性值计算为 x PROP = ∑ i m i ​ x i ∑ i m i . x_{\mathrm{PROP}}=\frac{\sum_{i}m_{i}x_{i}}{\sum_{i}m_{i}}.

paragraphs.en: All monetary values are converted from the reported local currency and year to 2017 purchasing-power-parity (PPP) international dollars. This harmonization reduces differences caused by currencies, price levels, and purchasing power across cities and years. The released field represents the mean property value within a tile in 2017 PPP international dollars. The original property values are also retained for reference and reproducibility.
paragraphs.zh: 所有货币数值均由报告的当地货币和年份换算为2017年购买力平价（PPP）国际元。 这种统一化处理减少了不同城市和年份之间因货币、价格水平和购买力造成的差异。 发布的字段表示2017年购买力平价（PPP）国际元下一个地块内的平均房产价值。 原始房产价值也予以保留，以供参考和复现。

sents.en: All monetary values are converted from the reported local currency and year to 2017 purchasing-power-parity (PPP) international dollars.
sents.zh: 所有货币数值均由报告的当地货币和年份换算为2017年购买力平价（PPP）国际元。

sents.en: This harmonization reduces differences caused by currencies, price levels, and purchasing power across cities and years.
sents.zh: 这种统一化处理减少了不同城市和年份之间因货币、价格水平和购买力造成的差异。

sents.en: The released field represents the mean property value within a tile in 2017 PPP international dollars.
sents.zh: 发布的字段表示2017年购买力平价（PPP）国际元下一个地块内的平均房产价值。

sents.en: The original property values are also retained for reference and reproducibility.
sents.zh: 原始房产价值也予以保留，以供参考和复现。

paragraphs.en: Missing values remain unavailable rather than being replaced with zero. The released value remains in physical units; the log1p transformation and train split standardization are applied only in the model input pipeline.
paragraphs.zh: 缺失值保持不可用状态，而不是被替换为零。 发布的数值保持物理单位；log1p 变换和训练集划分标准化仅在模型输入管道中应用。

sents.en: Missing values remain unavailable rather than being replaced with zero.
sents.zh: 缺失值保持不可用状态，而不是被替换为零。

sents.en: The released value remains in physical units; the log1p transformation and train split standardization are applied only in the model input pipeline.
sents.zh: 发布的数值保持物理单位；log1p 变换和训练集划分标准化仅在模型输入管道中应用。

paragraphs.en: For electricity, we aggregate the valid cell values within each tile by summing them and dividing by the nominal tile area. This produces the tile-level electricity density in kWh/km 2 /year. For partially supported tiles, we do not estimate the contribution from the missing area. The released value remains in its physical unit, while the model input pipeline applies log transformation and standardization. No additional resampling is applied to the original cell values.
paragraphs.zh: 对于电力，我们将每个瓦片内的有效栅格单元值通过求和并除以该瓦片的标称面积进行聚合。 由此得到瓦片级电力密度，单位为 kWh/km²/年。 对于部分覆盖的瓦片，我们不估算缺失区域的贡献。 发布的数值保持其物理单位，而模型输入流程会应用对数变换和标准化。 对原始栅格单元值不进行任何额外的重采样。

sents.en: For electricity, we aggregate the valid cell values within each tile by summing them and dividing by the nominal tile area.
sents.zh: 对于电力，我们将每个瓦片内的有效栅格单元值通过求和并除以该瓦片的标称面积进行聚合。

sents.en: This produces the tile-level electricity density in kWh/km 2 /year.
sents.zh: 由此得到瓦片级电力密度，单位为 kWh/km²/年。

sents.en: For partially supported tiles, we do not estimate the contribution from the missing area.
sents.zh: 对于部分覆盖的瓦片，我们不估算缺失区域的贡献。

sents.en: The released value remains in its physical unit, while the model input pipeline applies log transformation and standardization.
sents.zh: 发布的数值保持其物理单位，而模型输入流程会应用对数变换和标准化。

sents.en: No additional resampling is applied to the original cell values.
sents.zh: 对原始栅格单元值不进行任何额外的重采样。

paragraphs.en: For CO 2 , we aggregate the valid cell values within each tile by summing them and dividing by the nominal tile area. This produces the tile-level fossil-fuel CO 2 emission density in tonne C/km 2 /year. Valid zero values are retained. For partially supported tiles, we do not fill or scale up the missing area. The released value remains in its physical unit, while the model input pipeline applies log transformation and standardization. Each value corresponds to the supplied annual CO 2 product, with no additional temporal interpolation.
paragraphs.zh: 对于二氧化碳，我们对每个瓦片内的有效像元值进行汇总：先求和，再除以瓦片的标称面积。 由此得到瓦片级的化石燃料二氧化碳排放密度，单位为吨碳/平方公里/年。 有效的零值予以保留。 对于部分支持的瓦片，我们不填补或按比例放大缺失区域。 发布的数值保持其物理单位，而模型输入流程会进行对数变换和标准化。 每个数值均对应所提供的年度二氧化碳产品，未做额外的时间插值。

sents.en: For CO 2 , we aggregate the valid cell values within each tile by summing them and dividing by the nominal tile area.
sents.zh: 对于二氧化碳，我们对每个瓦片内的有效像元值进行汇总：先求和，再除以瓦片的标称面积。

sents.en: This produces the tile-level fossil-fuel CO 2 emission density in tonne C/km 2 /year.
sents.zh: 由此得到瓦片级的化石燃料二氧化碳排放密度，单位为吨碳/平方公里/年。

sents.en: Valid zero values are retained.
sents.zh: 有效的零值予以保留。

sents.en: For partially supported tiles, we do not fill or scale up the missing area.
sents.zh: 对于部分支持的瓦片，我们不填补或按比例放大缺失区域。

sents.en: The released value remains in its physical unit, while the model input pipeline applies log transformation and standardization.
sents.zh: 发布的数值保持其物理单位，而模型输入流程会进行对数变换和标准化。

sents.en: Each value corresponds to the supplied annual CO 2 product, with no additional temporal interpolation.
sents.zh: 每个数值均对应所提供的年度二氧化碳产品，未做额外的时间插值。

paragraphs.en: For Nighttime Lights, we compute the masked spatial mean of band 1 radiance within each tile and serialize the result with units of nW/cm 2 /sr. Radiance is averaged rather than summed because it represents an intensity field. Zero radiance is retained as a valid observation. The released value remains in its physical unit, while the model input pipeline applies log transformation and standardization. No additional sensor harmonization or reconstruction of missing historical years is performed.
paragraphs.zh: 对于夜间灯光数据，我们计算每个图块内波段1辐射掩膜后的空间均值，并以 nW/cm²/sr 为单位序列化结果。 辐射值采用平均而非求和，因为它表示的是一个强度场。 零辐射值被保留为有效观测。 发布的数值保持其物理单位，而模型输入管线则应用对数变换和标准化。 未执行额外的传感器统一化处理或缺失历史年份的重建。

sents.en: For Nighttime Lights, we compute the masked spatial mean of band 1 radiance within each tile and serialize the result with units of nW/cm 2 /sr.
sents.zh: 对于夜间灯光数据，我们计算每个图块内波段1辐射掩膜后的空间均值，并以 nW/cm²/sr 为单位序列化结果。

sents.en: Radiance is averaged rather than summed because it represents an intensity field.
sents.zh: 辐射值采用平均而非求和，因为它表示的是一个强度场。

sents.en: Zero radiance is retained as a valid observation.
sents.zh: 零辐射值被保留为有效观测。

sents.en: The released value remains in its physical unit, while the model input pipeline applies log transformation and standardization.
sents.zh: 发布的数值保持其物理单位，而模型输入管线则应用对数变换和标准化。

sents.en: No additional sensor harmonization or reconstruction of missing historical years is performed.
sents.zh: 未执行额外的传感器统一化处理或缺失历史年份的重建。

paragraphs.en: For GPS traces, we use tile-level attributes from the OSM GPS Trace GeoJSON rather than a rasterized trajectory image. Records are matched to benchmark tiles using their row and column indices or a parseable tile identifier. A tile is considered unavailable when no corresponding GPS feature or valid point-density value is present. The resulting modality represents the density of GPS sampling points captured in the public OSM trace data. It reflects observed GPS trace activity in the available sample and should not be interpreted as the number of unique travelers or trips, or as a direct measure of overall mobility.
paragraphs.zh: 对于GPS轨迹，我们使用OSM GPS轨迹GeoJSON中的瓦片级属性，而不是栅格化的轨迹图像。 记录通过其行索引和列索引或可解析的瓦片标识符与基准瓦片进行匹配。 当不存在对应的GPS要素或有效的点密度值时，该瓦片被视为不可用。 所得的模态表示公开OSM轨迹数据中捕获的GPS采样点的密度。 它反映的是可用样本中观测到的GPS轨迹活动，不应被解读为唯一的出行者或出行次数，也不应被解读为对整体出行活动的直接度量。

sents.en: For GPS traces, we use tile-level attributes from the OSM GPS Trace GeoJSON rather than a rasterized trajectory image.
sents.zh: 对于GPS轨迹，我们使用OSM GPS轨迹GeoJSON中的瓦片级属性，而不是栅格化的轨迹图像。

sents.en: Records are matched to benchmark tiles using their row and column indices or a parseable tile identifier.
sents.zh: 记录通过其行索引和列索引或可解析的瓦片标识符与基准瓦片进行匹配。

sents.en: A tile is considered unavailable when no corresponding GPS feature or valid point-density value is present.
sents.zh: 当不存在对应的GPS要素或有效的点密度值时，该瓦片被视为不可用。

sents.en: The resulting modality represents the density of GPS sampling points captured in the public OSM trace data.
sents.zh: 所得的模态表示公开OSM轨迹数据中捕获的GPS采样点的密度。

sents.en: It reflects observed GPS trace activity in the available sample and should not be interpreted as the number of unique travelers or trips, or as a direct measure of overall mobility.
sents.zh: 它反映的是可用样本中观测到的GPS轨迹活动，不应被解读为唯一的出行者或出行次数，也不应被解读为对整体出行活动的直接度量。

paragraphs.en: In Table 12 , optical imagery is treated as RGB images and retain bands 1-3 in the declared RGB order, while Planet band 4 is excluded. The supplied uint8 RGB values are preserved without per-tile contrast stretching and saved as PNG images.
paragraphs.zh: 在表12中，光学影像被视为RGB图像，并按声明的RGB顺序保留第1-3波段，同时排除Planet第4波段。 所提供的uint8 RGB数值被原样保留，不进行逐瓦片对比度拉伸，并保存为PNG图像。

sents.en: In Table 12 , optical imagery is treated as RGB images and retain bands 1-3 in the declared RGB order, while Planet band 4 is excluded.
sents.zh: 在表12中，光学影像被视为RGB图像，并按声明的RGB顺序保留第1-3波段，同时排除Planet第4波段。

sents.en: The supplied uint8 RGB values are preserved without per-tile contrast stretching and saved as PNG images.
sents.zh: 所提供的uint8 RGB数值被原样保留，不进行逐瓦片对比度拉伸，并保存为PNG图像。

paragraphs.en: In Table 12 , band 1 of DEM provides elevation in metres. We retain valid zero and negative elevations, exclude pixels marked as missing, and require at least 98% valid pixels. A fixed global linear grayscale mapping is used to produce DEM PNG image. As a result, a genuinely flat tile may have low visual contrast. DEM is treated as static terrain information and reused across years rather than as an annual measurement, according to previous work ( Helfenstein et al., 2024 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 在表 12 中，DEM 的第 1 波段以米为单位提供高程。 我们保留有效的零值和负值高程，排除标记为缺失的像素，并要求有效像素至少占 98%。 采用固定的全局线性灰度映射来生成 DEM PNG 图像。 因此，真正平坦的图块可能具有较低的视觉对比度。 根据以往的研究（Helfenstein et al., 2024），DEM 被视为静态地形信息并在多年间重复使用，而不是作为每年的观测数据。

sents.en: In Table 12 , band 1 of DEM provides elevation in metres.
sents.zh: 在表 12 中，DEM 的第 1 波段以米为单位提供高程。

sents.en: We retain valid zero and negative elevations, exclude pixels marked as missing, and require at least 98% valid pixels.
sents.zh: 我们保留有效的零值和负值高程，排除标记为缺失的像素，并要求有效像素至少占 98%。

sents.en: A fixed global linear grayscale mapping is used to produce DEM PNG image.
sents.zh: 采用固定的全局线性灰度映射来生成 DEM PNG 图像。

sents.en: As a result, a genuinely flat tile may have low visual contrast.
sents.zh: 因此，真正平坦的图块可能具有较低的视觉对比度。

sents.en: DEM is treated as static terrain information and reused across years rather than as an annual measurement, according to previous work ( Helfenstein et al., 2024 ) .

paragraphs.en: In Table 12 , band 1 of NDVI (Landsat) is rendered as NDVI PNG image, using a fixed palette over the range [ − 1 , 1 ] [-1,1] . paragraphs.en: In Table 13 , NO 2 and PM 2.5 are independently aggregated from AirQualityNO2 and AirQualityPM25, respectively. paragraphs.en: In Table 2 , for optical imagery (OPT), we report RGB mean squared error (MSE) and LPIPS to measure pixel-level fidelity and perceptual similarity, respectively. For continuous spatial fields (DEM, NDVI, and H&F), we use normalized mean absolute error (NMAE), while built volume (BV) is evaluated with log1p NMAE to account for its skewed dynamic range. For categorical land-cover (LC) and land-use (LU) maps, we use macro mIoU to measure class-wise spatial overlap while giving equal weight to each class. Road networks (RD) are evaluated with clDice, which is better suited to thin and connectivity-sensitive structures.
paragraphs.zh: 在表2中，对于光学影像（OPT），我们报告RGB均方误差（MSE）和LPIPS，分别用于衡量像素级保真度和感知相似性。 对于连续空间场（DEM、NDVI和H&F），我们使用归一化平均绝对误差（NMAE），而建筑体量（BV）则采用log1p NMAE进行评估，以考虑其偏斜的动态范围。 对于类别型的土地覆盖（LC）和土地利用（LU）地图，我们使用宏平均mIoU来衡量类别级的空间重叠度，同时给予每个类别相等的权重。 道路网络（RD）使用clDice进行评估，该指标更适用于细长且对连通性敏感的结构。

paragraphs.en: For categorical targets, macro mIoU averages IoU equally across semantic classes, while clDice evaluates centerline agreement and is therefore used for road-network structure. LPIPS complements MSE for OPT by measuring similarity in learned perceptual feature space rather than only pixel-wise differences. For every source-to-target route, the metric is determined solely by the target modality and is identical across all source modalities. NMAE and NMSE variants are multiplied by 100 100 and reported as percentages; MSE, LPIPS, macro mIoU, and clDice are reported on their native scales.

paragraphs.en: To prevent spatial leakage across resolutions, training, validation, and test partitions are defined using a common 10 ​ km × 10 ​ km 10\,\mathrm{km}\times 10\,\mathrm{km} parent grid. All 2 ​ km 2\,\mathrm{km} and 5 ​ km 5\,\mathrm{km} tiles within the same parent region are assigned to the same partition. All years and modalities associated with these tiles are kept together. Thus, spatially overlapping observations cannot enter different partitions through a change of scale, modality, or year. Candidate pairs are then sampled independently within each partition. For categorical modalities, content diversity is considered during sampling. For example, the coarse spatial support of land use data can produce tiles containing only one class; more diverse tiles are prioritized to provide useful supervision, while single-class tiles are retained at a lower sampling rate rather than removed entirely. Directed source–target routes are assigned approximately balanced sampling quotas, subject to their available pair counts, so that frequent routes do not dominate training and rare routes remain represented. Table 14 shows the number of samples provided by the benchmark. The sample selection procedure produces 269,472 directed translation instances: 172,032 for training, 48,720 for validation, and 48,720 for testing.
paragraphs.zh: 为防止跨分辨率的空间泄漏，训练集、验证集和测试集的划分采用统一的 10 km × 10 km 父网格来定义。 同一父区域内的所有 2 km 和 5 km 图块都被分配到同一划分中。 与这些图块相关的所有年份和模态均保持在一起。 这样，空间上重叠的观测就无法通过改变尺度、模态或年份进入不同的划分。 候选配对随后在各划分内独立采样。 对于类别型模态，采样时考虑内容多样性。 例如，土地利用数据粗糙的空间覆盖范围可能产生仅包含单一类别的图块；会优先采样更多样化的图块以提供有效的监督，而单类别图块则以较低的采样率保留，而非完全移除。 有向的源—目标路径被分配大致均衡的采样配额，并受其可用配对数量的限制，以避免高频路径主导训练，同时稀有路径仍得到表示。 表 14 展示了基准提供样本的数量。 样本选择流程共生成 269,472 个有向翻译实例：172,032 个用于训练，48,720 个用于验证，48,720 个用于测试。

paragraphs.en: All models were fine-tuned on NVIDIA H200 GPUs with 140 GB of memory. No LoRA modules or parameter-efficient adapters were introduced. All four baselines are fine-tuned from their released checkpoints without additional urban-specific adapters. For MODUS-7B, we freeze the VAE and fine-tune the LLM and unified diffusion transformer with a learning rate of 1 × 10 − 5 1\times 10^{-5} , cosine decay to 5 × 10 − 7 5\times 10^{-7} , and a 500-step warm-up on 3 × 3\times NVIDIA H200 GPUs. For Show-O2-1.5B, we freeze the Wan2.1 VAE and image and positional embeddings, while fine-tuning the remaining trainable components with learning rates of 5 × 10 − 6 5\times 10^{-6} for the visual encoder and 1 × 10 − 5 1\times 10^{-5} for the projection and generation components, using cosine decay with a 5% warm-up on one H200 GPU. For UniGen-1.5B, we freeze the MagViT-v2 visual tokenizer and fine-tune the Qwen2.5-1.5B backbone and generation layers with a learning rate of 2 × 10 − 5 2\times 10^{-5} , cosine decay to 1 × 10 − 6 1\times 10^{-6} , and a 500-step warm-up on one H200 GPU. For ML-4M-3B, we keep the pretrained modality tokenizers frozen and fully fine-tune the 4M transformer with a learning rate of 3.125 × 10 − 6 3.125\times 10^{-6} and cosine decay on one H200 GPU.
paragraphs.zh: 所有模型均在配备 140 GB 显存的 NVIDIA H200 GPU 上进行微调。 未引入任何 LoRA 模块或参数高效适配器。 所有四个基线模型均从其发布的检查点进行微调，未添加额外的城市专用适配器。 对于 MODUS-7B，我们冻结 VAE，以 1 × 10 − 5 1\times 10^{-5} 的学习率微调 LLM 和统一扩散Transformer，采用余弦衰减至 5 × 10 − 7 5\times 10^{-7}，并在 3 × 3\times NVIDIA H200 GPU 上进行 500 步预热。 对于 Show-O2-1.5B，我们冻结 Wan2.1 VAE 以及图像嵌入和位置嵌入，同时以视觉编码器 5 × 10 − 6 5\times 10^{-6}、投影与生成组件 1 × 10 − 5 1\times 10^{-5} 的学习率微调其余可训练组件，采用带 5% 预热的余弦衰减，在单块 H200 GPU 上进行训练。 对于 UniGen-1.5B，我们冻结 MagViT-v2 视觉分词器，以 2 × 10 − 5 2\times 10^{-5} 的学习率微调 Qwen2.5-1.5B 骨干网络和生成层，采用余弦衰减至 1 × 10 − 6 1\times 10^{-6}，并进行 500 步预热，在单块 H200 GPU 上进行训练。 对于 ML-4M-3B，我们保持预训练的模态分词器冻结，以 3.125 × 10 − 6 3.125\times 10^{-6} 的学习率和余弦衰减在单块 H200 GPU 上对 4M Transformer 进行全量微调。

paragraphs.en: This task provides a way to examine how information in one modality can support the generation of another. Table 2 provides an empirical map of which modalities contain information useful for reconstructing others. Because different targets have different value distributions and prediction characteristics, performance is not directly comparable across different targets. Comparisons are therefore most informative when the target modality is held fixed. Table 2 shows that activity modalities such as population, electricity, nighttime lights, GPS density, and carbon emissions exhibit clear relationships with each other. For example, GPS → \rightarrow POP, POP → \rightarrow ELEC, ELEC → \rightarrow NTL, and NTL → \rightarrow GPS achieve NMSEs of 0.219%, 1.318%, 2.450%, and 2.488%, respectively. For the same target, these activity-related sources also provide useful information compared with other modality types. In particular, POP predicts ELEC with an NMSE of 1.318%, compared with 37.500% for RD → \rightarrow ELEC, indicating that population intensity is considerably more informative about electricity distribution than road geometry alone.
paragraphs.zh: 本任务提供了一种方法，用于考察一种模态中的信息如何能够支持另一种模态的生成。 表 2 提供了一份实证图谱，展示了哪些模态包含对重建其他模态有用的信息。 由于不同的目标具有不同的数值分布和预测特性，不同目标之间的性能不能直接比较。 因此，只有在目标模态保持不变时，比较才最具参考价值。 表 2 显示，人口、电力、夜间灯光、GPS 密度和碳排放等活动类模态彼此之间存在明显的关系。 例如，GPS → POP、POP → ELEC、ELEC → NTL 和 NTL → GPS 分别实现了 0.219%、1.318%、2.450% 和 2.488% 的 NMSE。 对于相同的目标，与其他类型的模态相比，这些活动相关的来源也提供了有用的信息。 特别是，POP 预测 ELEC 的 NMSE 为 1.318%，而 RD → ELEC 为 37.500%，这表明人口密度信息对电力分布的指示作用远强于仅凭道路几何信息。
